task_scope: New task for this comparison, already development-exposed in earlier diagnostics. Not unseen, not hidden pilot; no earlier run or candidate is resumed.
authorization: Current user instruction: verify a new already-qualified development-exposed task, freeze B0/B1, run once each and retain failures, costs and five categories of data.

platform.B0: Same fixed platform, with only navigation_only assigned False instead of navigation >= NAVIGATION_STAGNATION_THRESHOLD.
platform.shared: Both retain navigation telemetry, recovery, exact-repeat/public-failure feedback, resource admission and blocked-outcome repairs.
platform.why: 为什么要有它：两臂都包含平台修复，单独比较导航触发的提示；不能拿旧缺陷版本作新基线。

common_conditions.task_input: Identical qualified public baseline, public reproduction and environment patch; exact UTF-8 public problem text only. No technical hints, answer patches or independent grader inputs in model requests.
common_conditions.permissions_tools_checks: Same registered repository profile, allowed paths, tool schemas and existing execution owner; private grader stays external to the task agent.
common_conditions.cold_start: Unload the selected model before each arm and verify no resident models; record service version and digest. Other machine workload/cache effects are not claimed eliminated.
common_conditions.why: 为什么要有它：实际策略、输入、权限与预算均须相同，避免把环境差异或外层帮助归因于反馈机制。

preflight.rules: Use existing validate_navigation_experiment on the actual bound execution config. Match copied worker to its original and freeze its reference. Check source, owner/dependency, public input, SDK and model identities. Require at least 3 GiB free before pair preparation and 1.5 GiB before B1; do not delete old evidence to make room.
preflight.interpretation: Declared navigation-phase time includes entry preparation. Capacity supports the registered action sequence, not a guarantee about model choice, response size or runtime speed.
preflight.why: 为什么要有它：触发条件须在真实资源配置中可达，准入不能来自未被执行的旧配置或预测出的成功。

measurements.primary: Whether B1 actually receives navigation feedback, then selects a non-navigation action within the next three completed model responses. Count proposed, executed, rejected and replayed actions separately.
measurements.business: Valid candidate, public checks, original final-only independent grade, and same-candidate actual isolated delivery are separate results. Correct delivery requires independent acceptance and verified delivery of the same source version.
measurements.costs: All observed calls, retries, recovery and auxiliary calls; input/output/cache token components, bytes, wall time and unknowns. Separate qualification/preparation, task, independent grade and platform development. Human active time only measured or explicitly declared.
measurements.experience: Off in both arms; adoption/transfer gain remains not measured.
measurements.why: 为什么要有它：选择工具、产生候选、修对业务和减少用户工作是不同结果，不能由单一通路指标替代。

stop_and_decision.per_arm: Stop at the registered wall or model budget; each arm starts at most once. No mid-run patch, resource adjustment or task rescue.
stop_and_decision.platform_failure: Preserve the failed arm and leave any later arm unstarted if platform identity, ordinary terminal projection, authority or owned-process cleanup fails. Ordinary validated blocked outcomes or bounded timeouts are task results, not automatically platform failures.
stop_and_decision.no_exposure: If the intervention is not delivered, report it as not exposed and do not infer benefit or harm.
stop_and_decision.behavior_only: A B1 non-navigation choice without a valid candidate and independent correct delivery supports only the stated behavioral observation.
stop_and_decision.negative: If both arms stagnate or fail, retain the negative result and end; no threshold tuning or same-task rerun to obtain a positive result.
stop_and_decision.limits: One exposed task cannot establish general repair superiority, resume-level competitive performance or experience transfer.
stop_and_decision.why: 为什么要有它：运行前固定结束和归因规则，防止看到结果后延长实验或扩大收益主张。

deferred: T2 broader real safe-input correction comparison
return_point: After this one comparison or a precise admission/platform stop, publish the five-category record and technical decision, then reselect the existing queue. No evaluator framework or full recovery refactor.
prohibited_replays: old B12 or any historical run identity
